title: ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT~ESO Very Large Telescope
focus: 四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的薄主鏡、可變形副鏡、雷射導引星、干涉延遲線與 coudé 光譜整合~Thin primaries, deformable secondary, laser guide stars, interferometric delay lines and coudé spectroscopy across four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes
summary: 以 Paranal 山頂四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡為對象，從視寧度與繞射的差距出發，拆解 Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與多焦點、177 mm 薄 Zerodur 主鏡製作、1170 致動器可變形副鏡、四雷射導引星、VLTI 延遲線與 ESPRESSO 的 10 cm/s 量測，最後整合成多望遠鏡的營運交接。~Taking the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes on Cerro Paranal, start from the gap between seeing and diffraction and work through the Ritchey–Chrétien train and its foci, the 177 mm thin Zerodur primary, the 1170-actuator deformable secondary, four laser guide stars, VLTI delay lines and ESPRESSO's 10 cm/s measurement, ending in a multi-telescope operational handoff.

units.anchor: 四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡~Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes
units.title: 集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界~Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary
units.mechanism: VLT 由四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡、四座可移動的 1.8 m 輔助望遠鏡與地下干涉實驗室組成，涵蓋近紫外到 25 µm。口徑帶來兩種好處：集光面積讓暗弱天體在有限時間內達到訊雜比，角解析度則理論上隨 λ/D 變好；但大氣湍流把波前切成尺寸約 Fried 參數 r₀ 的同調區塊，未修正時影像寬度由 λ/r₀ 決定，與口徑無關。因此 VLT 的工程設計一直沿著兩條線前進：把四座望遠鏡的光合在一起增加集光或基線，以及以主動與自適應光學把影像拉回繞射極限。~The VLT comprises four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes, four relocatable 1.8 m Auxiliary Telescopes and an underground interferometric laboratory, covering the near ultraviolet to 25 µm. Aperture brings two benefits: collecting area lets faint targets reach a useful signal-to-noise ratio in finite time, and angular resolution in principle improves as λ/D. Atmospheric turbulence, however, breaks the wavefront into coherent patches of about the Fried parameter r₀, so the uncorrected image width is set by λ/r₀ regardless of aperture. VLT engineering has therefore advanced along two lines: combining the four telescopes for more collecting area or longer baselines, and using active and adaptive optics to pull images back toward the diffraction limit.
units.model: 取 r₀ = 0.15 m（500 nm，假設），視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″，而 8.2 m 的繞射極限 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas，差 40 倍以上；D/r₀ ≈ 55，瞳面約含 (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 個同調區塊。四座 UT 非同調合光的等效口徑為 √4 × 8.2 m = 16.4 m。~Take r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm (assumption): seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″, while the 8.2 m diffraction limit 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas is more than 40 times smaller; D/r₀ ≈ 55, so the pupil holds about (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 coherent patches. Incoherently combining the four UTs gives an equivalent aperture of √4 × 8.2 m = 16.4 m.
units.verify: 以差分影像運動監測器（DIMM）量 r₀ 與視寧度，並同時記錄望遠鏡導星相機的影像 FWHM；把兩者換算到相同波長與天頂角（FWHM ∝ λ^−1/5、∝ sec z^3/5）比較，差額即為望遠鏡本身與圓頂的貢獻，再與影像品質預算比對。~Measure r₀ and seeing with a differential image-motion monitor (DIMM) while logging image FWHM from the telescope guide camera; convert both to the same wavelength and zenith angle (FWHM ∝ λ^−1/5 and ∝ sec z^3/5) and compare, treating the difference as the telescope and enclosure contribution to be checked against the image-quality budget.
units.failure: 若只看口徑而忽略站址與局部湍流，8 m 級望遠鏡的影像會和 1 m 級望遠鏡一樣寬，只多了集光；更常見的是把圓頂內熱湍流誤當成大氣視寧度，導致錯誤地升級光學而非改善熱控。~Judging a telescope by aperture alone, without site and local turbulence, leaves an 8 m class telescope with images as wide as a 1 m telescope and only more light; more commonly, dome thermal turbulence is mistaken for atmospheric seeing and the optics are upgraded instead of the thermal control.
units.misconception: 望遠鏡口徑加倍，地面影像的解析度就一定加倍。~Doubling the aperture always doubles the resolution of ground-based images.

units.anchor: Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點~Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci
units.title: RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置~RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci
units.mechanism: 每座 UT 為 Ritchey–Chrétien 設計：f/1.8 的薄主鏡與剛性輕量化的凸雙曲面副鏡共同消除球差與彗差，經地平式機架指向全天。光可以送到主鏡下方的 Cassegrain 焦點、兩側的 Nasmyth 焦點，或再經轉折送到地下的 coudé 焦點，讓大型穩定儀器固定不動。副鏡單元以五個自由度定位：一軸對焦、兩軸置中、兩軸指向；因為副鏡把主鏡焦比放大約 8 倍，副鏡的微小軸向位移會在焦面被放大，所以副鏡對焦是主動光學閉環中最頻繁的修正。~Each UT is a Ritchey–Chrétien design: an f/1.8 thin primary and a rigid, lightweight convex hyperboloidal secondary jointly cancel spherical aberration and coma, pointed over the whole sky by an alt-azimuth mount. Light can go to the Cassegrain focus below the primary, to the two Nasmyth foci at the sides, or be relayed to a coudé focus in the basement so that large, stable instruments stay fixed. The secondary unit is positioned in five degrees of freedom: one for focus, two for centring and two for pointing. Because the secondary magnifies the primary focal ratio about eightfold, small axial secondary motions are amplified at the focal plane, which makes secondary focus the most frequent correction in the active-optics loop.
units.model: 主鏡曲率半徑約 28.8 m，焦距 14.4 m，焦比 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76。若 Nasmyth 焦比約 f/15，副鏡放大率 m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5，焦面位移 ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz：副鏡移動 10 µm 使焦點移 0.74 mm，而 500 nm 的焦深 ±2λN² 只有 ±0.23 mm。等效焦距 123 m 對應底片比例尺 ≈ 1.68″/mm。~The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76. With a Nasmyth ratio near f/15 the secondary magnification is m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5 and the focal shift is ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz: a 10 µm secondary move shifts focus by 0.74 mm, while the 500 nm depth of focus ±2λN² is only ±0.23 mm. The 123 m effective focal length gives a plate scale ≈ 1.68″/mm.
units.verify: 在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較；再以已知角距的星對量測底片比例尺，並在不同仰角重複，分離重力撓曲造成的置中與彗差。~Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction; then measure plate scale on star pairs of known separation and repeat at several elevations to separate gravity-flexure-induced decentre and coma.
units.failure: 副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。~A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma; if it is mistaken for primary figure error and handed to the primary actuators, the primary is loaded with unnecessary forces and new aberrations appear after an elevation change.
units.misconception: 副鏡只是轉折光路的鏡子，位置差幾十微米沒有影響。~The secondary only folds the beam, so tens of micrometres of position error do not matter.

units.anchor: 8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡~8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary
units.title: 薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數~Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant
units.mechanism: UT 主鏡是直徑 8.2 m、厚約 177 mm 的 Zerodur 彎月鏡，成品重約 23 t；每片由 SCHOTT 澆鑄約 45 t 的玻璃陶瓷，經約 3 個月退火與 9 個月陶瓷化，膨脹係數規格 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K，交貨量測約 −0.03 到 −0.04×10⁻⁶/K。REOSC 在模擬最終鏡室的 150 點氣動支撐上研磨拋光，因為薄鏡本身不保形，驗收必須在主動模式下進行：允許致動器以有限的力修正低階面形，交付的波前約 40 nm RMS。薄鏡的另一個好處是熱慣量小，能跟上夜間氣溫，減少鏡面視寧度。~Each UT primary is a Zerodur meniscus 8.2 m across and about 177 mm thick, weighing about 23 t finished; SCHOTT cast about 45 t of glass ceramic per blank, followed by roughly 3 months of annealing and 9 months of ceramisation, to a thermal-expansion specification of 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K, with delivered blanks measuring about −0.03 to −0.04×10⁻⁶/K. REOSC ground and polished on a 150-point pneumatic support that mimics the final cell; because a thin mirror cannot hold its own shape, acceptance is done in active mode, letting actuators correct low-order figure with limited forces, and delivered wavefronts were about 40 nm RMS. The thin mirror's low thermal inertia also lets it follow the night-time air temperature, reducing mirror seeing.
units.model: Zerodur 熱擴散率 κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s，厚度 t 的熱時間常數 τ ≈ t²/(π²κ)：t = 0.177 m 時約 1.3 h；若用 1:6 厚徑比的傳統鏡（t ≈ 1.37 m）則約 75 h，重量也從 23 t 增加到約 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t。~Zerodur's diffusivity is κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s, and the thermal time constant of thickness t is τ ≈ t²/(π²κ): about 1.3 h for t = 0.177 m, but about 75 h for a conventional 1:6 mirror (t ≈ 1.37 m), whose mass would also rise from 23 t to about 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t.
units.verify: 拋光驗收時在多個支撐方位量全口徑干涉相位圖，扣除主動光學可修正的低階模態後計算殘差 RMS、斜率與中心強度比；營運中以鏡面溫度感測器與氣溫的差值追蹤熱平衡，並比對該差值與影像 FWHM 的相關性。~For polishing acceptance, take full-aperture interferometric phase maps at several support orientations, remove the low-order modes that active optics can correct and compute residual RMS, slope error and central-intensity ratio; in operation, track the mirror-to-air temperature difference with surface sensors and correlate it with image FWHM.
units.failure: 支撐點的力誤差或吊運時的局部應力會在薄鏡上直接留下面形印記；若鏡面比夜間空氣溫度高 1 K 以上，鏡面上方形成上升熱羽，影像 FWHM 增加，被誤判為大氣視寧度變差。~Force errors at support points or local stress during handling print directly into the figure of a thin mirror; if the mirror runs more than about 1 K warmer than the night air, a rising thermal plume forms above it and image FWHM grows, often misread as worse atmospheric seeing.
units.misconception: 主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。~A thicker, stiffer primary always gives better image quality.

units.anchor: 1170 致動器可變形副鏡~1170-actuator deformable secondary
units.title: 可變形副鏡：薄殼、音圈致動器與散熱~Deformable secondary: thin shell, voice coils and heat removal
units.mechanism: UT4 的自適應光學設施把原本的剛性副鏡換成直徑 1120 mm、厚約 2 mm 的 Zerodur 薄殼可變形副鏡，背後以 1170 個音圈致動器推動；薄殼由 SAGEM 製作，參考體由 SESO 以輕量化 Zerodur 製造，系統由 Microgate 與 ADS International 整合。每個致動器旁有電容感測器量測薄殼與參考體的約 90 µm 間隙，內迴路以 80 kHz 維持形狀，這層空氣膜同時提供阻尼。把自適應元件放在副鏡，讓所有焦點共用修正且不增加額外反射面與熱背景。致動器與電子機箱的熱必須以液冷帶走，否則副鏡附近形成局部湍流。~The UT4 Adaptive Optics Facility replaced the rigid secondary with a deformable secondary: a Zerodur shell 1120 mm across and about 2 mm thick, pushed by 1170 voice-coil actuators. SAGEM produced the shell, SESO the lightweighted Zerodur reference body, and Microgate with ADS International integrated the system. A capacitive sensor beside each actuator measures the roughly 90 µm gap between shell and reference body, an internal loop at 80 kHz holds the shape, and the air film provides damping. Putting the adaptive element at the secondary lets all foci share the correction without extra reflections or thermal background. Heat from actuators and electronics must be carried away by liquid cooling, or local turbulence forms around the secondary.
units.model: 致動器最小間距約 28 mm，投影到 8.2 m 瞳面約 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m。連續面形的擬合誤差 σ² ≈ 0.28(d/r₀)^5/3：K 波段 r₀ ≈ 0.89 m（由 500 nm 的 0.15 m 以 λ^6/5 換算）時 σ² ≈ 0.024 rad²，只看擬合項 Strehl ≈ 0.98；可見光 r₀ = 0.15 m 時 σ² ≈ 0.47、Strehl ≈ 0.62。散熱 1326 W、流量 4.5 L/min 的水冷液溫升約 4.2 K。~The minimum actuator pitch of about 28 mm projects to about 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m on the 8.2 m pupil. The continuous-facesheet fitting error σ² ≈ 0.28(d/r₀)^5/3 gives σ² ≈ 0.024 rad² and a fitting-only Strehl ≈ 0.98 in K band with r₀ ≈ 0.89 m (scaled from 0.15 m at 500 nm by λ^6/5), but σ² ≈ 0.47 and Strehl ≈ 0.62 in the visible with r₀ = 0.15 m. Removing 1326 W with 4.5 L/min of water raises the coolant by about 4.2 K.
units.verify: 在實驗室以干涉儀量薄殼在每個致動器單位推力下的影響函數，建立影響矩陣並量測平面化後的殘差；上機前用專用測試台以人工光源量閉迴路的擬合誤差與頻寬；上機後比較冷卻液出入口溫差與副鏡周圍的溫度感測器，確認沒有熱羽進入光路。~In the laboratory measure the shell's influence function for a unit force on each actuator with an interferometer, build the influence matrix and measure the flattened residual; before installation measure closed-loop fitting error and bandwidth on a dedicated test bench with an artificial source; after installation compare coolant inlet-outlet temperatures with sensors around the secondary to make sure no thermal plume enters the beam.
units.failure: 灰塵或顆粒卡在 90 µm 間隙中會讓局部致動器無法到位，薄殼出現凸點甚至破裂；冷卻流量不足時，電子機箱發熱使副鏡附近溫度上升，影像品質在自適應光學閉迴路中仍無法改善。~Dust or particles caught in the 90 µm gap stop local actuators from reaching position, leaving a bump or even cracking the shell; with insufficient coolant flow, electronics heat raises the temperature near the secondary and image quality fails to improve even with the AO loop closed.
units.misconception: 致動器越多越好，與觀測波長無關。~More actuators are always better, regardless of the observing wavelength.

units.anchor: 四雷射導引星設施~Four Laser Guide Star Facility
units.title: 雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長~Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation
units.mechanism: 自然亮星很少落在目標附近，因此 UT4 以四雷射導引星設施在約 90 km 高的鈉層激發四顆人造星。四顆導引星環繞視場，GRAAL 模組把地表層湍流修正後的影像送給 HAWK-I，GALACSI 則為 MUSE 做地表層或雷射斷層修正。雷射星位於有限高度，光錐只取樣部分湍流（錐效應），且鈉層有約 10 km 厚度，從望遠鏡不同位置看到的雷射光點會被拉長，次孔徑離發射點越遠拉得越長。雷射星也無法量測整體傾斜，所以仍需要一顆暗的自然星提供傾斜資訊。~Bright natural stars rarely lie near a target, so UT4 uses the Four Laser Guide Star Facility to excite four artificial stars in the sodium layer at about 90 km. The four guide stars surround the field; the GRAAL module feeds ground-layer-corrected images to HAWK-I, and GALACSI provides ground-layer or laser-tomography correction for MUSE. Because a laser star sits at finite altitude, its light cone samples only part of the turbulence (the cone effect), and because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, the spot seen from different parts of the pupil is elongated, more so for subapertures farther from the launch point. Laser stars also cannot measure overall tilt, so a faint natural star is still needed for tip-tilt.
units.model: 光點拉長角 ≈ b·Δh/H²：次孔徑距發射點 b = 8 m（假設）、鈉層厚 Δh = 10 km、高度 H = 90 km 時，拉長 ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″，遠大於次孔徑繞射寬度，量測斜率的雜訊因而在拉長方向變大。~Spot elongation ≈ b·Δh/H²: for a subaperture b = 8 m from the launch point (assumption), a 10 km thick sodium layer at H = 90 km gives ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″, far wider than a subaperture's diffraction width, so slope noise grows along the elongation direction.
units.verify: 以波前感測器影像量各次孔徑雷射光點的長軸與短軸寬度，對次孔徑到發射點的距離作圖，檢查是否符合 b·Δh/H² 的線性關係並反推鈉層厚度；再與同時段的鈉層剖面或回波強度紀錄比對，確認重心演算法的加權設定。~Measure long- and short-axis widths of the laser spot in each subaperture from wavefront-sensor frames, plot them against distance from the launch point to check the linear b·Δh/H² relation and back out the sodium-layer thickness; compare with contemporaneous sodium-profile or return-flux records to confirm the weighting used by the centroid algorithm.
units.failure: 鈉層高度在夜間變化數公里時，雷射星的對焦也跟著改變；若沒有以自然星的慢速對焦感測修正，系統會把鈉層高度變化誤當成望遠鏡離焦，科學影像持續失焦。~When the sodium-layer altitude changes by kilometres during the night, the laser-star focus changes with it; without slow natural-star focus sensing, the system interprets sodium-height changes as telescope defocus and the science image stays out of focus.
units.misconception: 有了雷射導引星就完全不需要自然星。~With laser guide stars no natural star is needed at all.

units.anchor: VLTI 延遲線隧道~VLTI delay-line tunnel
units.title: VLTI 基線、延遲線與光程差預算~VLTI baselines, delay lines and the OPD budget
units.mechanism: VLTI 把兩到四座望遠鏡的光經地下光管送到延遲線，延遲線是放在長軌道上的貓眼反射車，隨地球自轉連續移動以補償幾何光程差，使各路光在合光器處等光程而產生干涉條紋。UT 間基線可達約 130 m，輔助望遠鏡可移到不同基座組成約 200 m 的基線。條紋對比（可見度）攜帶目標的空間頻率資訊，但只要各路光程差抖動接近波長的十分之一，可見度就明顯下降；GRAVITY 等儀器以條紋追蹤器在 K 波段即時量測並回授到延遲線，再以雷射計量量測內部光程。~VLTI sends light from two to four telescopes through underground light ducts to the delay lines, cat's-eye carriages on long rails that move continuously with Earth rotation to cancel the geometric path difference so that all beams arrive at the combiner with equal path and form fringes. Baselines between UTs reach about 130 m, and the Auxiliary Telescopes can be moved between stations to form baselines of about 200 m. Fringe contrast (visibility) carries the target's spatial-frequency information, but once the path-difference jitter approaches a tenth of the wavelength the visibility drops markedly; instruments such as GRAVITY measure fringes in K band with a fringe tracker that feeds back to the delay lines, and laser metrology measures internal paths.
units.model: 幾何延遲變化率最大約 B·Ω⊕：B = 130 m 時 130 × 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s ≈ 9.5 mm/s。K 波段角解析度 λ/(2B) ≈ 2.2 µm/260 m ≈ 1.7 mas，200 m 時約 1.1 mas。光程差抖動 σ = 150 nm 時相位抖動 2πσ/λ ≈ 0.43 rad，可見度衰減因子 exp(−σφ²/2) ≈ 0.91。~The geometric delay rate peaks near B·Ω⊕: for B = 130 m, 130 × 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s ≈ 9.5 mm/s. K-band resolution λ/(2B) ≈ 2.2 µm/260 m ≈ 1.7 mas, and about 1.1 mas at 200 m. An OPD jitter σ = 150 nm gives phase jitter 2πσ/λ ≈ 0.43 rad and a visibility loss factor exp(−σφ²/2) ≈ 0.91.
units.verify: 以內部光源量測各延遲線的光程差功率譜，找出機械共振與振動源；在天上觀測已知直徑的校準星，比較量到的可見度與預期值得到系統傳遞函數，再以望遠鏡上的加速度計量測各鏡面振動，追蹤哪一座望遠鏡貢獻最多光程差抖動。~Measure the OPD power spectrum of each delay line with an internal source to locate mechanical resonances and vibration sources; observe calibrator stars of known diameter and compare measured with expected visibility to obtain the system transfer function; use accelerometers on the telescope mirrors to track which telescope contributes most of the OPD jitter.
units.failure: 機房泵浦或冷卻機的數十 Hz 振動經基座傳到鏡面，光程差抖動達數百奈米，條紋追蹤器跟不上而反覆失鎖，可見度被系統性壓低，若不以校準星修正，會被誤解為目標被解析。~Pump or chiller vibration at tens of hertz travels through the foundations to the mirrors and drives hundreds of nanometres of OPD jitter; the fringe tracker repeatedly loses lock and visibilities are systematically depressed, which without calibrator correction is misread as a resolved target.
units.misconception: 只要基線夠長，干涉儀的角解析度就自動實現，與光程穩定度無關。~With a long enough baseline the interferometer's resolution is achieved automatically, regardless of path stability.

units.anchor: ESPRESSO 與合併 coudé 實驗室~ESPRESSO and the combined coudé laboratory
units.title: coudé 光路與 10 cm/s 徑向速度量測~Coudé trains and 10 cm/s radial-velocity measurement
units.mechanism: ESPRESSO 位於合併 coudé 實驗室，可經 coudé 光路收單一 UT 的光，或同時收四座 UT 的光（非同調合併），以換取更暗目標的訊雜比。它的目標是在十年尺度上達到 10 cm/s 的徑向速度精度，解析度依模式約 70,000、140,000 或 190,000。要量到如此小的都卜勒位移，光譜儀必須放在真空、毫開爾文級溫控的環境中，以光纖與散射器穩定照明，並以頻率梳或 Fabry–Pérot 標準具同時記錄波長參考；望遠鏡端的導星與大氣色散補償則決定光纖入口的照明穩定性。~ESPRESSO sits in the combined coudé laboratory and receives light from one UT through its coudé train, or from all four UTs at once (incoherent combination) to gain signal-to-noise on fainter targets. Its goal is 10 cm/s radial-velocity precision over a decade, with resolving power of about 70,000, 140,000 or 190,000 depending on mode. Measuring such tiny Doppler shifts requires the spectrograph to sit in vacuum with millikelvin-class temperature control, fibre feeds with scramblers to stabilise illumination, and a frequency comb or Fabry–Pérot etalon recorded simultaneously as wavelength reference; guiding and atmospheric-dispersion correction at the telescope set how stable the fibre entrance illumination is.
units.model: Δλ/λ = v/c：v = 0.10 m/s 在 550 nm 時 Δλ ≈ 550 nm × 3.3×10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 1.8×10⁻¹⁶ m。R = 140,000 的解析元素為 3.9 pm，若以 4 像素取樣，每像素約 0.98 pm，位移只有 1.9×10⁻⁴ 像素；以 15 µm 像素計約 2.8 nm 的焦面位移。~Δλ/λ = v/c: v = 0.10 m/s at 550 nm gives Δλ ≈ 550 nm × 3.3×10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 1.8×10⁻¹⁶ m. At R = 140,000 the resolution element is 3.9 pm; sampled by 4 pixels, each pixel spans about 0.98 pm, so the shift is only 1.9×10⁻⁴ pixel, about 2.8 nm on the focal plane for 15 µm pixels.
units.verify: 以同時參考通道記錄頻率梳或標準具譜線的漂移，與科學通道的漂移相減；長期觀測已知穩定的標準星，計算數月到數年的徑向速度散佈，並以太陽或標準星的晝夜資料檢查是否有與溫度、壓力或光纖照明相關的系統項。~Record the drift of comb or etalon lines in the simultaneous reference channel and subtract it from the science-channel drift; monitor standard stars known to be quiet over months to years and compute the radial-velocity scatter, checking solar or standard-star data for systematics correlated with temperature, pressure or fibre illumination.
units.failure: 導星偏差讓星像在光纖入口移動，若散射不足，光譜線輪廓隨之改變，產生數十 cm/s 的假速度訊號；真空槽溫度漂移 0.01 K 也可透過光柵與鏡座膨脹造成同量級的偏移，被誤認為行星訊號。~Guiding errors move the star on the fibre entrance; with insufficient scrambling the line profile changes and produces spurious velocities of tens of cm/s, and a 0.01 K drift of the vacuum vessel can cause shifts of similar size through grating and mount expansion that are mistaken for a planet signal.
units.misconception: 只要解析度夠高，徑向速度精度就不受儀器穩定度限制。~With high enough resolving power, radial-velocity precision is not limited by instrument stability.

units.anchor: 主鏡單元維護與鍍膜~Primary-mirror unit maintenance and coating
units.title: 多望遠鏡營運：主鏡重鍍、通量與交接~Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff
units.mechanism: 四座 UT 各有不同焦點的常駐儀器，營運上要協調哪座望遠鏡做 VLTI、哪座做自適應光學、哪座提供 coudé 光，維護計畫也必須錯開。主鏡單元約 50 t，需從望遠鏡卸下送到山上的鍍膜廠清洗並重鍍鋁膜；灰塵沉積會逐步降低反射率並增加熱輻射背景，對中紅外儀器尤其不利。交接紀錄要包含每座望遠鏡的影像品質、主動光學力圖、自適應光學性能、延遲線狀態與反射率歷史，才能讓下一個觀測期的排程以實際能力為準。~The four UTs carry resident instruments at different foci, so operations must coordinate which telescope serves VLTI, which runs adaptive optics and which feeds the coudé laboratory, and maintenance must be staggered. The roughly 50 t primary-mirror unit is removed from the telescope and taken to the on-site coating plant for cleaning and aluminium recoating; dust gradually lowers reflectance and raises thermal background, which hurts mid-infrared instruments in particular. The handoff record must include each telescope's image quality, active-optics force maps, AO performance, delay-line status and reflectance history so that the next period's schedule rests on actual capability.
units.model: Nasmyth 光路經 M1、M2、M3 三次反射。新鍍鋁膜反射率取 0.92（假設）時通量 0.92³ ≈ 0.779；每面因灰塵降到 0.90 時為 0.90³ ≈ 0.729，同樣訊雜比所需積分時間增加約 0.779/0.729 ≈ 1.068 倍，即約 7%。中紅外每面發射率若因灰塵從 0.02 增至 0.03（假設），三面合計約從 0.06 增至 0.09，10 µm 熱背景增加約 50%。~The Nasmyth train has three reflections, M1, M2 and M3. With freshly coated aluminium at 0.92 reflectance (assumption) throughput is 0.92³ ≈ 0.779; if dust lowers each to 0.90 it becomes 0.90³ ≈ 0.729, so integration time for the same signal-to-noise grows by about 0.779/0.729 ≈ 1.068, about 7%. If dust raises the mid-infrared emissivity of each mirror from 0.02 to 0.03 (assumption), the three-mirror total grows from about 0.06 to 0.09 and the 10 µm thermal background by about 50%.
units.verify: 以攜帶式反射率計定期量測主鏡多個位置的反射率與散射，並以標準星的光度零點追蹤整體通量；重鍍後重新量測主動光學力圖與影像品質，確認卸裝與再安裝沒有改變支撐與對準，再把結果寫入營運交接紀錄。~Measure reflectance and scatter at several points on the primary periodically with a portable reflectometer and track overall throughput through photometric zero points of standard stars; after recoating, remeasure active-optics force maps and image quality to confirm that removal and reinstallation did not change support or alignment, and enter the results in the operational handoff record.
units.failure: 重鍍排程若只看反射率而不看中紅外背景，熱紅外儀器的靈敏度會在數月內悄悄下降；主鏡重新安裝後若沒有重做主動光學查表，早期觀測會帶著殘餘像散，浪費寶貴的觀測時段。~If recoating is scheduled on reflectance alone and ignores mid-infrared background, thermal-infrared sensitivity quietly degrades over months; if active-optics look-up tables are not redone after reinstallation, early observations carry residual astigmatism and waste valuable observing time.
units.misconception: 鏡面反射率降低幾個百分點，對望遠鏡效能幾乎沒有影響。~A few percent of lost reflectance hardly affects telescope performance.

example: UT4 自適應光學 K 波段練習：假設 500 nm 的 r₀ = 0.15 m，換算到 2.2 µm 為 r₀ = 0.15 × (2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 0.89 m。擬合誤差以投影間距 0.205 m 計 σ_fit² ≈ 0.28 × (0.205/0.89)^5/3 ≈ 0.024 rad²；風速 15 m/s 時 Greenwood 頻率 f_G = 0.427v/r₀ ≈ 7.2 Hz，假設修正頻寬 60 Hz，時間誤差 σ_t² = (7.2/60)^5/3 ≈ 0.029 rad²；另給雜訊與混疊 0.03 rad²。總和 0.084 rad²，Strehl ≈ exp(−0.084) ≈ 0.92。修正後影像寬約 λ/D ≈ 55 mas，而 K 波段未修正視寧度約 0.50″，相差約 9 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表 VLT 的實際規格。~UT4 adaptive-optics exercise in K band: assume r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm, which scales to r₀ = 0.15 × (2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 0.89 m at 2.2 µm. With a projected pitch of 0.205 m the fitting error is σ_fit² ≈ 0.28 × (0.205/0.89)^5/3 ≈ 0.024 rad²; for a 15 m/s wind the Greenwood frequency is f_G = 0.427v/r₀ ≈ 7.2 Hz, and with an assumed 60 Hz correction bandwidth the temporal error is σ_t² = (7.2/60)^5/3 ≈ 0.029 rad²; allow 0.03 rad² for noise and aliasing. The total is 0.084 rad² and Strehl ≈ exp(−0.084) ≈ 0.92. The corrected image is about λ/D ≈ 55 mas wide, against about 0.50″ of uncorrected K-band seeing, a factor of about 9. Values are teaching assumptions, not VLT specifications.
history: ESO 於 1980 年代後期決定建造由四座 8 m 級望遠鏡組成的 VLT，並選定智利 Cerro Paranal 為站址；第一座 UT 於 1998 年取得初光，其餘三座在之後數年陸續完成，VLTI 也在 2000 年代初取得首批條紋。2016 年 UT4 的自適應光學設施以 1170 致動器可變形副鏡與四雷射導引星取得初光，使 VLT 從被動大口徑轉向以自適應光學與干涉為核心的平台。~ESO decided in the late 1980s to build the VLT as four 8 m class telescopes and chose Cerro Paranal in Chile as the site; the first UT saw first light in 1998, the other three followed over the next few years, and VLTI obtained its first fringes in the early 2000s. In 2016 the UT4 Adaptive Optics Facility reached first light with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and four laser guide stars, turning the VLT from a passive large-aperture facility into a platform built around adaptive optics and interferometry.
